Links now resolve by filename, and two older forms stop resolving: a document's
heading, and a `../` path.

An Area written before 0.3 keeps working. Those links go quiet, so run
`dokito validate` once after upgrading — it names every link that no longer
resolves, and for a `../` path it names the filename to write instead.

Also in this release:

- `dokito resolve <reference>` turns a link target into local paths, searching
  every registered Area.
- `dokito validate --links` adds the checks that depend on this machine, such
  as whether a referenced Repository is checked out.
- `[[project:…]]`, `[[task:…]]` and `[[repo:…/path]]` reference a Project, a
  Task, or a file inside a connected Repository.
- The Web view names a Resource by its file, heading included, so only one name
  has to be kept.
